sectionsContent.title: Acceleration & the Kinematic Equations

concept.summary: Acceleration is the rate a velocity changes, in m/s per second. It is a vector, so a negative acceleration does not mean “slowing down” — it means pointing in the negative direction. The four kinematic equations each leave out one quantity, so you choose by asking which one you neither have nor want.
keyIdeas: An object slows down when a and v point opposite ways, whatever their signs.
Pick the equation by what is missing, not by what looks familiar.
Write your givens with signs before you choose an equation.

items: Displacement carries a sign; distance does not (S1.1).
Average velocity as Δx over Δt (S1.1).
Solving a quadratic, and knowing when to keep both roots (U0 S0.3).

sectionsContent.directions: Work every problem in your Hayden-McNeil notebook. Write the givens with signs, then name the equation you chose before you use it.

questions.prompt: Iron Man boosts away from another one of Fury's meetings, speeding up from 5 m/s to a faster cruise, accelerating at 3 m/s² for 4 s. Find his **final velocity**.
The Flash decelerates from 30 m/s to 10 m/s in 4 s — still faster than your last Uber driver. Find his **acceleration**.
Thor launches off the ground from rest and accelerates at 6 m/s² for 4 s before he levels off. Find the **distance** he covers before leveling off.
Batman's grappling hook reels him up from rest over a displacement of 20 m, reaching a final speed of 8 m/s — he's trying to beat Alfred to dinner. Find his **acceleration**.
SpongeBob's boat-mobile pulls away from the Krusty Krab drive-through at 4 m/s and accelerates at 2 m/s² for 5 s. Find the **distance** it covers.
questions.solution: Δx = v0t + ½at² = (4 m/s)(5 s) + ½(2 m/s²)(5 s)² = 20 m + 25 m = 45 m.

questions.prompt: The Batmobile speeds up from 15 m/s to 35 m/s while covering 250 m of Gotham docks — Alfred texted that dinner's getting cold again. Find the **time** that took.
parts: Which of the four equations doesn't need acceleration at all?
questions.solution: No acceleration given or needed, so use Δx = ((v0+v)÷2)t → 250 m = ((15+35)÷2)t = 25t → t = 10 s.

questions.prompt: Patrick Star rolls down a Bikini Bottom hill starting at 2 m/s, accelerating at 3 m/s², covering 40 m before he stops rolling. Find the **time** it took. Keep only the positive root.
Aquaman jets off from rest, accelerating at 2 m/s² for 6 s, then coasts at whatever velocity he reached for another 10 s. Find the **total distance** covered across both phases.
parts: Two phases, two calculations — find the velocity at the end of phase 1 before you touch phase 2.
questions.solution: Phase 1: Δx1 = v0t + ½at² = 0 + ½(2)(6)² = 36 m; v at end of phase 1 = v0+at = 0+2(6) = 12 m/s. Phase 2: constant 12 m/s for 10 s → Δx2 = 12(10) = 120 m. Total = 36 + 120 = 156 m.

questions.prompt: Wonder Woman accelerates uniformly from 4 m/s to 22 m/s over a 30 m sprint. First use v² = v₀² + 2aΔx to find her **acceleration**, then find the **time** using v = v₀ + at.
parts: Confirm your time with Δx = ((v₀ + v) ÷ 2)t — it should come back to 30 m.

questions.prompt: Batman and Robin drag race down a straight stretch of the Gotham docks, starting at the same moment. Batman starts from rest and accelerates at 4 m/s². Robin starts 20 m ahead of Batman and holds a constant 12 m/s, no acceleration. Find the **time** it takes Batman to catch up, and his **velocity** at that moment.
parts: Write both positions as functions of time and set them equal — Robin's head start is part of his position, not a separate step.
questions.solution: Batman: x_B = ½(4)t² = 2t². Robin: x_R = 20 + 12t. Set equal: 2t² = 20 + 12t → 2t² − 12t − 20 = 0 → t² − 6t − 10 = 0. t = [6 ± √(36+40)] ÷ 2 = [6 ± √76] ÷ 2. Positive root: t = (6+8.72)÷2 = 7.36 s. Batman's velocity: v = at = 4(7.36) = 29.4 m/s. Check: x_B = 2(7.36)² = 108.3 m and x_R = 20+12(7.36) = 108.3 m, matching.
